method: Playwright headless Chromium, sitemap-driven (no search queries)
robots_txt: checked — no AI bot blocks, /refer/ and /wp-admin/ blocked only
notes: version is the build number (e.g. 15.0.3.116SP02), NOT a security patch level
region_code is the firmware regional variant (e.g. OP001PF001AZ = Global/Operator)
Devices with no firmware versions are explicitly recorded (note column)
chipset extracted from page text where present
